summary: Xiaoling Wu was a sinologist and Indologist. He held posts at Visva-Bharati University (~1942–1946), Peking University (~1946–1949), and as professor at Academia Sinica (~1953–1977) and the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences (~1977–1995).
Xiaoming Hou works in Buddhist studies and sinology. Hou was a doctoral student at Ghent University and served there as a postdoctoral researcher, both attested in 2026.

Xiaoting Wei works in sinology, Buddhist studies, and other fields. Wei completed an MA under supervisor Cheng Mei Ku at the National University of Singapore (attested 2004) and served as Associate Lecturer at the Australian National University in 2016.

Xin Huang specializes in Tibetology and linguistics. Huang earned a master's at Sichuan Normal University (2003–2006), was a visiting scholar at Sichuan University (2018–2019), and held professorships at Sichuan Minzu College (2012–2016), Sichuan Normal University (2016–2019), and Nanning Normal University (2023).

Xinchuan Huang worked in Indology, Buddhist studies, and philosophy. After studying at Peking University (~1954–1958), Huang served as a researcher (研究員) at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences from ~1979 to 2021, and taught Jiang Yili.

Xinguang Ma is a scholar of religious studies, history/archaeology, and Buddhist studies. Ma studied at Northwest University and holds a post in the School of Chinese Language and Literature at Shanxi Normal University.

Xinru Liu specializes in Indology, history/archaeology, and Iranian and Central Asian studies. After completing a PhD under Ludo Rocher at the University of Pennsylvania (~1981–1985), Liu held posts at CASS (~1985–2000) and The College of New Jersey (~2001–2017).
Xiuzhi Zeng specializes in Buddhist and religious studies. Zeng completed an MA at Nanhua University under supervisor Meihua Chen, attested in 2006.

Xu Dishan was a scholar of sinology, Buddhist studies, and religious studies. He studied at Yenching, Columbia, and Oxford, and held posts at Peking University (~1920–1922), Tsinghua University (~1930–1935), and the University of Hong Kong (~1935–1941).

Xue Yu specializes in Buddhist and religious studies and earned an MPhil from the University of Hong Kong (2011–2013). Posts include assistant professor at CUHK (attested 2010), professor at PBIS (attested 2026), and visiting professor at the University of Chicago (attested 2026).

Xuesong Zhang works in Buddhist and religious studies. Zhang earned a PhD at The Chinese University of Hong Kong under Xue Yu (attested 2008) and was an associate professor at Renmin University of China (attested 2015).

Xuezhu Li specializes in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and Indology, and studied under Shoryu Katsura. Li was a Numata fellow at Ryukoku University in 2011 and has served as Research Associate at the China Tibetology Research Center (attested 2010–2026).
Y. B. Damle studied under Govind Sadashiv Ghurye. Damle served as Professor of Sociology at Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute (attested 2026).

Yadi Qu specializes in Indology, Tibetology, and computational fields. Qu studied and served as a research project employee (Wissenschaftliche Projektmitarbeiterin) at the University of Hamburg (attested 2026).

Yael Bentor specializes in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. Bentor studied at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem and Indiana University Bloomington (doctoral supervisor Gregory Schopen), and served as a professor at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem (attested 1995–2026).

Yakupitiyage Karunadasa specialized in Buddhist studies and philosophy, earning degrees from the University of Ceylon and SOAS under David Friedman. He served as Director (~1980–2000) and Emeritus Professor at PBIS, and held visiting posts at SOAS, Calgary, Toronto, and HKU.
Yandong Hou is a Tibetology scholar who studied at the Nanjing Institute of Geography and Limnology and held a post there.

Yanfei Zhao specializes in Buddhist and religious studies. Zhao completed an MA (2016–2019) and pursued doctoral studies (2023) at Beijing Foreign Studies University, earned an MA at SOAS (2021–2022), and was a visiting PhD student at Yale (2025–2026).
Yanfei Zhou specializes in Buddhist studies, history/archaeology, and sinology. Zhou completed a PhD at the National University of Singapore under the supervision of Yuet-Keung Lo.
Yang-Gyu An specializes in Buddhist studies. An completed a D.Phil. at the University of Oxford under Richard Gombrich by 1998, and also studied under Hojin (attested 2003).
